_note: Board outlines and mounting holes in mm. Holes are [x, y] from the board's lower-left corner, seen from above with the long side along x. Values match NopSCADlib's pcbs.scad; check the datasheet when a fit is critical. In OpenSCAD the NopSCADlib constant gives the full board with connectors: pcb(TYPE), and pcb_cutouts(TYPE) cuts the openings for its connectors in an enclosure wall (NopSCADlib centres the board on the origin).

raspberry-pi-5.name: Raspberry Pi 5
raspberry-pi-5.notes: Same outline and hole pattern as the Pi 4; the ports differ (no NopSCADlib model, use RPI4 for the outline only).

raspberry-pi-4.name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B
raspberry-pi-4.notes: USB-A and Ethernet stick out about 2-8.5 mm past the short edge at x = 85.

raspberry-pi-zero.name: Raspberry Pi Zero / Zero W / Zero 2 W

raspberry-pi-pico.name: Raspberry Pi Pico / Pico W
raspberry-pi-pico.notes: Micro-USB (USB-C on some clones) at the short edge x = 0.

arduino-uno.name: Arduino Uno R3
arduino-uno.notes: USB-B and the barrel jack stick out past the short edge at x = 0.

arduino-nano.name: Arduino Nano
arduino-nano.notes: Usually soldered to headers or a socket instead of screwed down; pins at 0.1" pitch, rows 15.24 mm apart.

esp32-devkit.name: ESP32 DevKit V1 (DOIT, 30 pins)
esp32-devkit.notes: Clones vary by a millimetre or two (38-pin versions are about 55 x 28 mm): leave 1 mm clearance and ask the user to measure theirs. Micro-USB at the short edge x = 0; pin rows 25.4 mm apart.

seeed-xiao.name: Seeed Studio XIAO (SAMD21/RP2040/ESP32-C3/S3)
seeed-xiao.notes: No mounting holes: hold it in a pocket or on its castellated pins. USB-C at the short edge x = 21.

18650-cell.name: 18650 Li-ion cell
18650-cell.notes: Cylinder 18.3-18.6 mm diameter, 65 mm long unprotected; protected cells with button tops are up to about 70 mm. Holders: allow 19 mm diameter and the spring contacts' length.

relay-module-1ch.name: 1-channel 5 V relay module (HW-803)
relay-module-1ch.notes: The relay sticks up about 15-19 mm; screw terminals on one short edge. Many layouts exist: ask the user to measure theirs.

rotary-encoder-ky040.name: KY-040 rotary encoder module
rotary-encoder-ky040.notes: Shaft 6 mm with a 7 mm threaded bushing (M7): a panel hole of 7.5 mm holds it with its nut.

lcd-1602.name: LCD 1602A character display (16x2)
lcd-1602.notes: The display frame on top is 71.3 x 24.3 x 7 mm, centred on the board; the visible area is about 64.5 x 14.5 mm. An I2C backpack on the back adds about 12 mm.

buck-converter-mp1584.name: MP1584EN 3 A buck converter module
buck-converter-mp1584.notes: No mounting holes (the corner holes are the IN/OUT pads): hold it in a pocket or on standoffs glued under it. Components up to about 4 mm high, the trimpot on top.

charger-tp4056.name: TP4056 Li-ion charger module
charger-tp4056.notes: No mounting holes; micro-USB (USB-C on newer ones) at the short edge x = 0, sticking out about 1 mm. Hold it in a pocket with a slot for the USB plug.

boost-converter-mt3608.name: MT3608 boost converter module
boost-converter-mt3608.notes: No mounting holes (the 4 holes are the IN/OUT pads); the trimpot is about 10 mm high.

fan-30mm.name: 30 mm fan (30x30x10)
fan-30mm.notes: Screw holes 24 mm apart; blade opening about 27 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M3 screws through the frame.

fan-40mm.name: 40 mm fan (40x40x11)
fan-40mm.notes: Screw holes 32 mm apart; blade opening about 37 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M3 screws through the frame.

fan-50mm.name: 50 mm fan (50x50x15)
fan-50mm.notes: Screw holes 40 mm apart; blade opening about 48 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M4 screws through the frame.

fan-60mm.name: 60 mm fan (60x60x15)
fan-60mm.notes: Screw holes 50 mm apart; blade opening about 57 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M4 screws through the frame.

fan-80mm.name: 80 mm fan (80x80x25)
fan-80mm.notes: Screw holes 71.5 mm apart; blade opening about 75 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M4 screws through the frame.

fan-120mm.name: 120 mm fan (120x120x25)
fan-120mm.notes: Screw holes 105 mm apart; blade opening about 116 mm diameter (cut a round hole or a grille of that size). Self-tapping fan screws or M4 screws through the frame.

nema17-stepper.name: NEMA 17 stepper motor
nema17-stepper.notes: Face 42.3 mm square; M3 threaded holes 31 mm apart; centre boss 22 mm diameter, 2 mm high (cut a 22.5 mm hole); shaft 5 mm with a flat. Body length 20-60 mm (47 mm common): ask which one.
